edits.value_json: "The received form has two distinct analyses: Shuowen depicts a pregnant figure enclosing an unformed child, while 字源 reads 勹 as wrapping 巳, together conveying 胞衣, in a semantic construction. Other analyses propose 勹 as a sound component. A competing proposal derives 包 from a separate child-holding graph that first wrote 抱; no dated forms establish that descent. The earliest formation remains unresolved."

"Shuowen depicts 巳 as an unborn child. 字源 instead treats it as the child in a semantic construction with 勹, together conveying 胞衣. These distinct received-form analyses do not settle the earliest graph."

This is an attributed proposal, not a verified earliest attestation or artifact chronology; the separate 胞 entry’s estimate concerns 胞, not 包’s component analysis."
